info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Underwritings-v1-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Underwriting API enables users to retrieve detailed information about mortgage loan underwritings. This endpoint provides insights into various underwriting criteria and decisions for loans, facilitating better risk assessment and underwriting analysis. Typical consumers of this API include mortgage brokers, lenders, and financial analysts seeking to understand underwriting standards and outcomes. Use cases may involve generating reports or informing lending decisions based on historical underwriting data.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details regarding the loan underwriting process. It provides insights into the status and requirements associated with loan applications.

requestBody.description: Request body for the underwriting process of loans. This body contains essential details required for assessing the loan application during the underwriting phase.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the underwriting information.
